testo:
Blocker
■ When you put this creature, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures that costs 7 or less and put it into its owner's mana zone.
■ At the end of your turn, put the top card of your deck into your graveyard. Then return a card from your graveyard to your hand.
testo_jp:
Blocker
■ このクリーチャーが出た時、相手のコスト7以下のクリーチャーを1体選び、持ち主のマナゾーンに置いてもよい。
■ 自分のターンの終わりに、自分の山札の上から1枚目を墓地に置く。その後、カードを1枚、自分の墓地から手札に戻す。
